title: Fynaptix · Weekly Brief
heading: Emerging Tech Weekly
subheading: Nine sectors · one view · Refreshes Mondays ~12:30pm
disclaimer: Not financial advice · do your own due diligence

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. A chip rout on Oct 22 (SOX −6.7%, ~$200B erased, Nvidia −4.4% to $212) followed Meta's Q3 (capex floor raised to $135B, free cash flow −$2.1B) and Lam Research's supply-constraint warning, even as TSMC posted a record quarter.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: The constraint is still financing, not demand: AI debt issuance is above $500B this year and CoreWeave's bonds yield near 15%. Microsoft and Alphabet (Oct 28) and Amazon (Oct 29) are the next capex reads; Anthropic's reported mid-November IPO at ~$1.5T has no public S-1 yet.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. Tesla's Q3 (Oct 21) gave no dated Optimus milestones (R&D +69%, operating income −56%), Fanuc's ADR jumped 8.75% on a beat, and Intuitive posted a record 546 placements.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Industrial and surgical demand is real (IFR sees 655K installs in 2026; da Vinci procedures ~+15%) but humanoid valuations still outrun shipments. Agility's SPAC vote on Nov 2 is the next listing test.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. Lockheed raised FY26 guidance and hit a record $292B backlog, RTX and Northrop also raised, and Red Cat bid for Steyr Motors as the drone group (JEDI +7%) rebounded.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Demand is intact but the continuing resolution to Dec 11 still freezes 150+ new starts including Golden Dome; the UK Budget (Oct 28) is the next test for BAE's 3% timetable, and Palantir (Nov 2) and Rheinmetall (Nov 5) report after.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. Oklo made a new 52-week low of $26.35 (−83% from its high) and Barclays cut NuScale to Underweight (Citi to Sell), despite AEP, Amazon and X-energy announcing a proposed 960 MW Xe-100 plant in Indiana.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Physical uranium is firm (long-term $97/lb) yet listed names keep de-rating, and no commercial SMR operates. Oklo's ~$1B at-the-market programme keeps dilution live; BWXT (Nov 2), NuScale and Centrus (Nov 5) and Oklo (Nov 6) report next.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. MP ($38.30), USA Rare Earth ($9.33) and REMX all closed near 52-week lows and Lynas fell 5.9% to a new low after reports that GM ended its VAC South Carolina magnet supply deal.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Correction: China's suspension of its Oct 2025 rare-earth controls lapses Nov 10 (not Jan 10) with no renewal announced; lithium carbonate is down ~27% in a month. MP reports Nov 5 and the policy binary follows five days later.

sector_scoreboard.story: AST SpaceMobile cut to Watch (Q2 revenue miss, Piper downgrade, SpaceX spectrum push) and BlackSky added to Watch. SpaceX's Q3 beat (revenue $14.6B, +161%) lifted shares to ~$148 and Musk said SpaceX and Tesla boards formed merger committees.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: SpaceX is increasingly an AI-capex story (Q4 capex guided to $35–40B) and lockup supply continues (328M shares Oct 24, ~798M around Dec 8). Rocket Lab ($52.60) reports Nov 9 with Neutron slipped to 2027.

sector_scoreboard.story: Stem cut to Avoid after an NYSE continued-listing notice (Oct 23; $3.01, ~$29M market cap). Tesla's Q3 storage was 13.7 GWh with a 33.1% margin flattered by a $526M tariff refund, Fluence sits at $5.59 and GE Vernova fell to $815.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Margins are being propped up by one-offs and policy: Eos printed a −54% gross margin on +170% revenue, CATL's profit growth lagged revenue, and the China export tax rebate ends Jan 1. GE Vernova (Oct 28) tests its $176B backlog.

sector_scoreboard.story: No stance changes. Biotech bounced part-way (XBI +3.6% to $149.54), Tempus rose 6% on an expanded Bristol Myers Squibb data deal, Illumina sits above its average target into Oct 29 earnings, and Novartis fell 3.3% on weak MS data.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: No AI-discovered drug has full FDA approval; Novartis (Oct 27), Lilly and Illumina (Oct 29) and Tempus (Nov 2) are the next checks, with the tooling cohort reporting Nov 4-9.

sector_scoreboard.story: No Core/Speculative changes; Infleqtion is newly tracked at Watch. After the dilution-driven crash the group stalled near its lows (IonQ $31.27, Quantinuum $36.50, QTUM −1%) and an Oct 22 chip selloff erased a one-day bounce.
sector_scoreboard.fundamentals_check: Sector revenue is ~$1.5B against multi-billion pure-play market caps (P/S 54-418x) and the Elisity share issuance is still ahead; IonQ and Quantinuum both report Nov 5 as the first tests of guidance.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Two cuts and two new Watch names: balance-sheet stress drives the board
cross_cutting_themes.description: AST SpaceMobile goes from Speculative to Watch and Stem to Avoid, while BlackSky (Space) and Infleqtion (Quantum) enter at Watch. The pattern holds: the best ideas are good businesses, and the cuts are companies whose financing or listing status now outweighs the story.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Meta's negative free cash flow and CoreWeave's 15% bonds keep financing in focus
cross_cutting_themes.description: Meta lifted its 2026 capex floor to $135B with free cash flow of −$2.1B, and AI-related debt issuance is estimated above $500B this year. Lam Research's supply-constraint comment then triggered the Oct 22 chip rout (SOX −6.7%); Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon report Oct 28-29.

cross_cutting_themes.title: The 10-year eased to ~4.99% but Brent hit $116.72 and the Fed meets Wednesday
cross_cutting_themes.description: Treasuries rallied as equities sold off, yet Brent rose 3.1% and WTI 3.8% on Friday while gold slid below $4,000, its lowest since July. The Oct 28 FOMC is expected to hold at 3.75–4.00%, with December hike odds still elevated.

cross_cutting_themes.title: Three dated deadlines: Oct 28 UK Budget, Nov 10 rare earths, Dec 11 funding
cross_cutting_themes.description: China's suspension of its Oct 2025 rare-earth controls lapses Nov 10 with no renewal announced (the Jan 10 date applies to the wider trade truce); the continuing resolution blocks 150+ defense new starts until Dec 11; and US midterms land Nov 3.

cross_cutting_themes.title: IPO and lockup supply is building just as equities wobble
cross_cutting_themes.description: Anthropic is reportedly targeting a mid-November listing near $1.5T (public S-1 not filed as of Oct 24), OpenAI's raise was repriced to $1.25T, and SpaceX lockups add up to 328M shares on Oct 24 and ~798M around Dec 8. Dilution is also the sector bear case: Oklo's ~$1B ATM, Energy Fuels' $500M and Recursion's $200M.

news_of_the_week.title: Chip rout: SOX −6.7%, Nasdaq −2.6%, Dow down 600+ points
news_of_the_week.description: Lam Research flagged supply-constrained shipments and Meta's negative free cash flow revived doubts over AI-spend payback; Nvidia fell 4.4% to $212.21 and Brent neared $113. Treasury yields dropped ~17bp as money rotated into bonds.

news_of_the_week.title: SpaceX's first earnings: revenue $14.6B (+161%), shares jump ~8-10%
news_of_the_week.description: AI is now ~52% of revenue and Q4 capex is guided to $35–40B; Musk said SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to study a merger (no terms; shareholder approval would be required).

news_of_the_week.title: Tesla and Meta report: Optimus gets no dates, Meta raises its capex floor
news_of_the_week.description: Tesla's operating income fell 56% as R&D rose 69% to $2.76B; Meta's Q3 capex was $34.9B with free cash flow of −$2.1B and a 2026 range now $135–145B.

news_of_the_week.title: OpenAI raise reportedly repriced to $1.25T; Anthropic eyes mid-November IPO
news_of_the_week.description: CNBC reports up to $30B at $1.25T pre-money, below earlier $1.4T talk; Reuters says Anthropic targets ~$1.5T after Q3 revenue of $16.8B, though its public S-1 was still unfiled as of Oct 24.

news_of_the_week.title: Rare-earth stocks make new lows as GM ends a VAC magnet deal
news_of_the_week.description: MP closed $38.30, USAR $9.33 and Lynas fell 5.9%; the China export-control suspension lapses Nov 10 with no renewal announced.

week_ahead.title: Novartis, Enphase, Freeport and Seagate Q3
week_ahead.description: Novartis (on the Watch list) for AI partnership commentary after weak MS data; Enphase for residential storage demand.

week_ahead.title: FOMC, UK Budget, then Microsoft and Alphabet
week_ahead.description: Decision at 2:00pm ET with a hold at 3.75–4.00% expected; GE Vernova reports before the open and Microsoft and Alphabet after the close, extending the capex read.

week_ahead.title: Amazon, Intel, Lilly, Illumina and L3Harris
week_ahead.description: Amazon and Intel after the close; Lilly and L3Harris before the open and Illumina after; Lynas quarterly report and Q3 GDP and September PCE.

week_ahead.title: Employment Cost Index
week_ahead.description: Wage-inflation read that frames the December rate debate.

week_ahead.title: Palantir, BWXT and Tempus; Agility SPAC vote
week_ahead.description: Palantir guided ~$2.16B; Churchill XI holders vote on Agility Robotics; AMD (Nov 3) and US midterms (Nov 3) follow.

stance_changes.name: AST SpaceMobile
stance_changes.why: A Q2 revenue miss ($31.5M vs $34.4M), a $125.9M loss tied to the BB7 launch incident, Piper Sandler's downgrade and SpaceX's spectrum push outweigh $1.3B of backlog at ~$40.

stance_changes.name: BlackSky
stance_changes.why: Q2 revenue of $33.3M (+50%) with positive adjusted EBITDA is good progress, but a GAAP loss of $0.54 per share and a ~54% drop since April leave earnings quality unresolved.

stance_changes.name: Stem Inc
stance_changes.why: An NYSE continued-listing noncompliance notice on Oct 23, a $3.01 share price at the 52-week low and a ~$29M market cap make it uninvestable here despite positive adjusted EBITDA.

stance_changes.name: Infleqtion
stance_changes.why: Cheaper than peers at ~46x sales ($42.4M TTM revenue, +47%) with 30 logical qubits reported, but those rely on error detection, Morgan Stanley is only Equal Weight ($12 target) and it sits near its $8.38 low.
